gui.guhs.safari.fotograaf.hallo: Click-click! I'm Flitsguh. The closer, the sharper, and an animal doing something fun gives extra stars. Njeg, and don't move!
One panda ice cream! Careful, it's watching you with its chocolate eyes.
One zebra stripe! Or is it white with black stripes? Nobody knows.
One penguin ice cream! Eat it quickly, before it waddles off.
One flamingo sorbet! Eating it on one leg is allowed.

gui.guhs.safari.ijsverkoper.hallo: Welcome to the Ice Cream Stand! I'm Melty. Every animal ice cream costs %1$s Safari coins (you have %2$s). What'll it be, vads?
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.hint.0: Psst... yesterday I saw a %s far, far away, in the %s. Rare, you know! Don't tell anyone. Except you.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.hint.1: Do you know what I've never seen? A %s. They say it hides in the %s. If you find it, will you tell me?
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.hint.2: Tip from an old watcher guh: whoever is quiet in the %2$s might see a %1$s. I'm never quiet. That's why I never see it.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.niks: I see... grass. Very nice grass, mind you. I'll wait a little longer, an animal is bound to come by.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.0: Shh! There, through my binoculars... a %s! It doesn't know I can see it. Hehe.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.1: I've been sitting here since breakfast. I just saw a %s. Or was it a bush? No, a %1$s after all. I think.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.2: Look, look! A %s! I already have seventeen photos. All a bit blurry, but with lots of love.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.3: My binoculars say: %s. My tummy says: lunch. I'm listening to the binoculars first.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.4: A %s! It just looked straight at me. I waved back very politely, vads.
gui.guhs.safari.kijkguh.ziet.5: There goes a %s. Ten points for style and nine for waddling.
gui.guhs.safari.lodge.hallo: Welcome to the lodge! Take a hut: sleep here and you wake up here too. And early risers get double coins for their first photo of the day. Sleep tight, njeg!
gui.guhs.safari.lodge.vroege_vogel: Good morning, early bird! Your first photo today pays double Safari coins.

gui.guhs.safari.ranger.hallo: Hello there, junior ranger! I'm Guhmbo, head ranger of Safaripark Vadse Bergen. Can I help you with anything, njeg?
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.optie.tip: Got a tip of the day?
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.tip: Psst... this morning I saw the %1$s in the %2$s, somewhere near x %3$s, z %4$s. Sneak up carefully, chonk, or it hides!
gui.guhs.safari.ranger.uitleg: Spot and photograph every animal for your Safari-dex! At the experts' pavilion you get a badge when a zone is full. In the petting corner you can help out, in the gift shop you shop with Safari coins, and in the lodge you sleep like a log. Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.verkoper.hallo: Welcome to the gift shop! Everything for Safari coins, and nothing is too chonky.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.0: Once upon a time a giraffe wanted to whisper a secret. But by the time the secret got all the way down his neck, he had forgotten what it was. Now he just whispers "guh". Everybody thinks that's a fine secret.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.1: The penguins once threw a dance party. They danced all night, but nobody could tell it apart from walking. "That IS our dance," said the oldest penguin proudly.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.2: A hippo once tried to hide behind a single reed. Very still. VERY still. The ranger walked past three times and said: "Good morning, hippo." The hippo is still offended.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.3: The kangaroo once found a guh in her pouch. "How did you get in there?" she asked. "No idea," said the guh, "but it's warm and there are cookie crumbs." They are best friends now.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.4: The mammoth was too warm once. He wanted to take off his coat, but he couldn't, because he WAS his coat. Since then he lives in the Ice Age. Vahoeg, he says, much better.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.5: A zebra once walked past a freshly painted fence. Now she has one white stripe too many. Nobody noticed, except the zebra herself. She counts them every morning.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.6: The sloth started telling a joke on Monday. The punchline came on Friday. Everybody had forgotten the start, but they laughed anyway. That's how polite they are here.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.7: Once there was a panda who didn't feel like bamboo. "What do you want then?" asked the keeper. The panda thought for a very long time and said: "...bamboo." It was a long day.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.verhaal.8: Every evening the flamingos hold a contest: who can stand on one leg the longest. There has never been a winner, because they all fall asleep at the same time. Njeg.
gui.guhs.safari.verteller.welkom:
Come and sit down, vads, the fire is warm. Here, three marshmallows to roast. Listen...

%s

gui.guhs.safari.verzorger.voer: Here you go: a bit of everything, plus a brush and a lead if you didn't have them yet. Guess what they like today, njeg!
gui.guhs.safari.verzorger.voer.al: You already had a bag today, chonk. Tomorrow again!
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.1: Welcome to Safaripark Vadse Bergen! I'm Guhmbo, the head ranger. So glad you're here, chonk!
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.2: More than forty kinds of animals live here, from lions to sloths. Some hide really well, so look around carefully.
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.3: Photograph them for your Safari-dex: the nicer the photo, the more Safari coins.
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.3.camera: Here's your camera! Photograph the animals for your Safari-dex: the nicer the photo, the more Safari coins.
gui.guhs.safari.welkom.4: The experts in the pavilion, the petting corner, the gift shop and the lodge: have a look everywhere. Njeg, happy spotting!
gui.guhs.safari.bus.terug: Toot toot! The Guh safari bus takes you back home. See you on the next safari, vahoeg!

gui.guhs.safari.winkel.blauwdrukken.uitl: Build the lodge, the ranger post or the lookout tower at home. Coming soon, chonk!

item.guhs.safari_flamingosorbet.lore: Pink, sweet, and you can see everything at night.
item.guhs.safari_flamingosorbet.op: Flamingo sorbet! Your eyes sparkle in the dark.
item.guhs.safari_marshmallow.lore: From the campfire. Crispy outside, vads inside.
item.guhs.safari_pandaijsje.lore: Vanilla with chocolate ears. Nice and quick!
item.guhs.safari_pandaijsje.op: Mmm, panda ice cream! Your feet speed up all by themselves.
item.guhs.safari_pinguinijsje.lore: So cold it makes you swim.
item.guhs.safari_pinguinijsje.op: Brrr! You swim like a penguin now, njeg.
item.guhs.safari_zebrastreep.lore: Black, white, black, white... and hop!
item.guhs.safari_zebrastreep.op: Zebra Stripe! You jump like a happy zebra.
gui.guhs.safari.expert.kriebelhuis.nog: Ahem! Professor Kriebelguh, creepy-crawly connoisseur. *peers through magnifying glass* You've photographed %1$s of the %2$s Creepy-Crawly House species. %3$s to go! Look in the Night Hall too: they're awake by day in there, chonk.
gui.guhs.safari.expert.kriebelhuis.al: *peers through magnifying glass* Ah, a true creepy-crawly expert! Already %1$s of the %2$s species. Even found the stick insect? Vahoeg!
gui.guhs.safari.expert.kriebelhuis.belon: *drops magnifying glass* All species of %s in your dex?! Fascinating! Here's your zone badge and 100 Safari Coins. I'm writing this in my notebook right away, chonk.
gui.guhs.safari.kriebelhuis.balie.hallo: Welcome to the Kriebelhuis! Tickets are free, tickles too. First the terrarium, then the Kriebelzaal, the Nachtzaal (shh, some critters are sleeping) and the Diepzeezaal. Don't miss the pink tunnel, njeg!
gui.guhs.safari.kriebelhuis.winkel.hallo: A tickly welcome to the shop! Have a look around.
gui.guhs.safari.critter.blijft: This little critter lives here in the Kriebelhuis. Looking is fine, taking it home isn't, nyeg!
